title: Low Battery Guard
summary: Before a long upload, export or call, compares battery runway with the task's length and offers to start once plugged in.
description: Pre-task banner that compares battery runway (to a safety reserve, from the Battery Status API or a measured drain rate) with the task's length, shows where the battery would cut it off, and offers "Start when plugged in". Stays silent when the task will finish anyway.
catches: Task longer than the battery's remaining runway
Start when plugged in: runs the task once a charger connects
limits: The Battery Status API is missing in Safari and Firefox; then it uses your fallback
Runway is an estimate from current drain
Doesn't pause or resume the task itself
a11y: Runway bar is role=img with an aria-label giving runway and duration
Pulse animation is motion-safe only; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Upload died on a flat battery
